_about: Coaching layer over free-exercise-db for the exercises plans use. Written by the FitMind team from standard strength and conditioning practice; 'reviewed' turns true only after a certified trainer checks the entry. 'fixes' corrects known errors in the source data. 'needs' lists required equipment (onboarding values; 'a|b' means either; empty means bodyweight). 'loads' lists joints the exercise stresses, used to avoid injured areas. 'rep_range' fixes the reps for explosive exercises whatever the goal. 'tier' ranks an exercise for its muscle: S is a best-evidenced choice (loaded through a full range, ideally with a deep stretch, stable enough to push close to failure, easy to progress), A is solid, B is a stand-in for when nothing better fits the equipment or injuries. Plans always pick the highest tier the person can do. 'photos_from' shows another exercise's photos (the same movement with other equipment) for one that has none.

exercises.grip: No grip. Arms forward or hands together at the chest for balance.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, toes turned out 15 to 30 degrees.
steps: Stand tall and brace your stomach.
Sit down and back between your heels, letting knees travel forward over the toes.
Go as low as you can while keeping your heels down and back neutral.
Push the floor away to stand up.
cues: Knees follow the line of your toes.
Whole foot stays on the floor.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in on the way down, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Hold one dumbbell vertically or a kettlebell by the horns, close to your chest.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
steps: Hold the weight at chest height with elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your heels, keeping the weight close.
Lower until your elbows are near your knees or your back starts to round.
Drive up through the whole foot.
cues: Weight stays glued to your chest.
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.
Stay tall through the upper back.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift away from the body.
exercises.breathing: Big breath and brace before going down, breathe out near the top.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the shoulders, bar resting on the upper back (not the neck).
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart or a little wider, toes turned out.
steps: Set the bar in a rack at chest height and step under it.
Brace, stand the bar up and take two small steps back.
Squat down between your heels to at least thigh parallel if mobility allows.
Drive up, keeping chest and hips rising together.
cues: Knees track over the toes; going past the toes is fine.
Use safety pins set just below your bottom position.
mistakes: Hips shooting up faster than the chest.
Knees caving in on the way up.
Squatting without safety pins or a spotter.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in and brace at the top, hold through the bottom, breathe out near the top.

exercises.grip: Hands on hips, or hold a wall for balance.
exercises.stance: Staggered: one foot forward, one back, about a long stride apart, feet hip-width apart side to side.
steps: Stand in a split stance with weight mostly on the front foot.
Lower straight down until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: Move up and down like an elevator, not forward.
mistakes: Feet in a straight line (balance problems).
Pushing mostly off the back leg.
exercises.breathing: In on the way down, out as you rise.

exercises.grip: Hands on hips or arms relaxed at the sides.
exercises.stance: Start with feet hip-width apart; each step is a long stride.
steps: Take a long step forward.
Lower until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Alternate legs as you walk.
cues: Step long enough that the front shin stays fairly upright.
mistakes: Short steps that load the front knee hard.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you step through.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, stepping forward into a long stride.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells.
Step forward and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing through the front heel.
Alternate legs.
exercises.breathing: In on the way down, out as you push back.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, dumbbells at your sides.
exercises.stance: Whole working foot on a box or bench about knee height.
steps: Place one foot fully on the step.
Lean slightly forward and drive through that foot to stand on the step.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: The top leg does the work; don't push off the bottom foot.
mistakes: Step too high for your control.
exercises.breathing: Out as you step up, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the thighs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, knees softly bent.
steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually mid-shin, with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand.
cues: Bar stays in contact with the legs.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.
Turning it into a squat by bending the knees a lot.
Bar drifting away from the legs.
exercises.breathing: Brace and breathe in at the top, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, dumbbells in front of the thighs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and fixed.
steps: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the weights down close to your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings are fully stretched and the back is still flat.
Squeeze the glutes to return to standing.
cues: Push your hips toward the wall behind you.
exercises.breathing: In at the top, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Overhand or mixed grip just outside the legs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, bar over the middle of the foot.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and hinge down to grip it.
Bring shins to the bar, chest up, back flat.
Brace and push the floor away until you stand tall.
Lower by pushing the hips back, then bending the knees.
cues: Take the slack out of the bar before pulling.
Bar travels in a straight line close to the body.
Finish with glutes, not by leaning back.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor.
exercises.breathing: Big breath and brace before each rep, breathe out at the top.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart near your glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until body forms a line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze the glutes and pause for a second.
Lower slowly.
cues: Ribs down so the lower back doesn't arch.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
Feet too far from the body.
exercises.breathing: Out as you lift, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: One foot flat on the floor, the other leg extended or knee pulled to the chest.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel to lift the hips.
Keep the hips level at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Hips stay level, don't let one side drop.
exercises.breathing: Out as you lift, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles lightly.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-to-shoulder-width on the middle of the platform.
steps: Sit with your back and hips flat against the pad.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are around 90 degrees or your hips start to lift.
Press back up without locking the knees hard.
mistakes: Lowering so far the hips curl up off the seat.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Hold the handles at the front of the machine.
exercises.stance: Lying face down, pad just above the heels, knees just off the bench edge.
steps: Lie face down with the pad behind your ankles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to almost straight.
cues: Hips stay down on the bench.
mistakes: Hips lifting to swing the weight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles.
exercises.stance: Seated, back against the pad, knees lined up with the machine's pivot.
steps: Adjust the pad to sit just above the ankles.
Straighten your legs fully.
Squeeze the thighs for a second.
Lower with control.
cues: Knee joint lines up with the pivot point.
mistakes: Seat set so knees aren't aligned.
exercises.breathing: Out as you extend, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold a wall or rail lightly for balance.
exercises.stance: Balls of the feet on a step edge, heels hanging off, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Stand on the step edge.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch the calves.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
exercises.breathing: Out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands flat, slightly wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
exercises.stance: Feet together or hip-width apart, body in a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the body.
Go until the chest is just above the floor.
Push the floor away to return.
cues: Body moves as one straight plank.
Elbows angle back, not flared out to the sides.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you push up.

exercises.grip: Hands on a sturdy table, counter or wall, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet together, body straight and leaning on the hands.
steps: Place hands on a stable raised surface.
Walk your feet back until the body is straight.
Lower your chest to the edge.
Push back up.
cues: The higher the surface, the easier it is.
Straight line from head to heels.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you push.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, palms facing your feet, or slightly turned in.
exercises.stance: Lying on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Lie back holding the dumbbells over your chest.
Lower them to the sides of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees.
Press up until the arms are straight.
Bring the dumbbells slightly together at the top.
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back and down.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip a little wider than shoulders, wrists stacked over elbows.
exercises.stance: Lying on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades back and down.
Unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower it to the lower chest with elbows at about 45 to 70 degrees.
Press back up over the shoulders.
cues: Use a spotter or safety arms.
Touch the same spot each rep.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in and brace before lowering, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand or slightly turned-in grip.
exercises.stance: Bench set to 30 to 45 degrees, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Sit back on the incline with the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them up over the upper chest.
Lower slowly to the sides of the upper chest.
Repeat.
cues: Elbows slightly in front of the body.
mistakes: Bench set too steep (becomes a shoulder press).
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand or neutral grip, dumbbells at shoulder height.
exercises.stance: Seated with back support, or standing with feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them overhead until the arms are straight.
Lower with control to ear or chin height.
Repeat.
cues: Press slightly in front of the head.
mistakes: Clanging the weights at the top.
exercises.breathing: Out as you press, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the shoulders, forearms vertical.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, glutes and stomach tight.
steps: Start with the bar on the front of the shoulders.
Move your head back slightly and press the bar straight up.
Bring your head through once the bar passes it.
Lower the bar to the shoulders.
cues: Bar path is a straight line.
Squeeze glutes to protect the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Brace before pressing, breathe out at the top.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, light dumbbells at your sides.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, slight lean forward.
steps: Hold light dumbbells at your sides with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench, fingers forward, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Knees bent and feet flat (easier) or legs straight (harder).
steps: Sit on the edge and place your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the edge.
Bend your elbows to lower until they reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
cues: Stop at 90 degrees if shoulders feel strained.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the front of the shoulder.
Using a chair that can slide.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a straight or angled bar, hands about shoulder-width.
exercises.stance: Standing close to the cable, feet hip-width, slight forward lean.
steps: Hold the bar with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until the arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Let the bar rise until forearms are about parallel to the floor.
cues: Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
mistakes: Leaning over the bar to push with body weight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you push down, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Both hands cupping one end of a single dumbbell overhead.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbell straight overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten the arms to return.
cues: Elbows point forward and stay close.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you extend.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Hanging with legs straight or knees bent, body still.
steps: Hang from the bar with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower all the way with control.
cues: Start each rep from a full hang.
Drive elbows down toward your back pockets.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip, about shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Hanging, body still.
steps: Hang with palms facing you.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps.
Lower fully with control.
mistakes: Craning the neck to reach the bar.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: One knee or both feet in a band looped over the bar.
steps: Loop a band over the bar and place a knee or foot in it.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly.
cues: Use the lightest band that lets you do clean reps.
Control the band on the way down.
mistakes: Band too strong to feel the back working.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Seated, thighs under the pads, feet flat.
steps: Grip the bar and sit with thighs secured.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Let the bar rise until the arms are straight.
cues: Bar to the upper chest, not behind the neck.
mistakes: Leaning far back and rowing it.
Letting the weight yank the arms up.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip on a V-handle.
exercises.stance: Seated, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
steps: Sit tall holding the handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle to your stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Rounding the back at the front.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, palm facing your body.
exercises.stance: One hand and knee on a bench or sturdy chair, other foot on the floor; or a staggered stance with one hand on a table.
steps: Support yourself with one hand, back flat.
Let the dumbbell hang under the shoulder.
Row it toward your hip.
Lower until the arm is straight, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Pull toward the hip, not the chest.
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, a little wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, hinged forward with a flat back, knees soft.
steps: Hinge forward with the bar hanging at arm's length.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.
cues: Brace your stomach the whole set.
mistakes: Standing up more with each rep.
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a bar set at about hip height, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Lying under the bar, heels on the floor, body straight.
steps: Hang under the bar with straight arms and a straight body.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower until the arms are straight.
cues: Bend the knees to make it easier.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand or neutral grip on a rope attachment, thumbs toward you.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width, cable at upper-chest to face height.
steps: Hold the rope with arms straight in front.
Pull it toward your face, splitting the rope apart.
Finish with hands beside the ears and elbows high.
Return slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a light band, hands shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, arms straight in front at shoulder height.
steps: Hold the band in front with straight arms.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.
cues: Shoulders down away from the ears.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull apart, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip, palms facing forward.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, elbows by your sides.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides.
Curl them up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, palms facing each other.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Curl them up without rotating the wrists.
Pause near the shoulders.
Lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart on the toes, body in a straight line.
steps: Set your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Step your feet back and lift the body.
Hold a straight line from head to heels.
Rest on the knees if form breaks.
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace your stomach.
Push the floor away with the forearms.
exercises.breathing: Slow, steady breathing throughout.

exercises.grip: Forearm on the floor under the shoulder.
exercises.stance: Lying on your side, feet stacked or staggered, knees straight (or bent to make it easier).
steps: Lie on your side propped on one forearm.
Lift your hips so the body is straight.
Hold.
Switch sides.
cues: Straight line from head to feet.
mistakes: Rotating the chest toward the floor.
exercises.breathing: Steady breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms reaching straight up toward the ceiling.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
steps: Lie on your back with arms up and knees over the hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Lower back stays in contact with the floor.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as the arm and leg extend, in as they return.

exercises.grip: Hands crossed on the chest or lightly beside the head.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
cues: Curl the ribs toward the hips.
mistakes: Yanking the head with the hands.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl up, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent at 90 degrees, shins parallel to the floor.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet lifted.
Curl your hips up off the floor toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
cues: Roll the pelvis, don't swing the legs.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a pull-up bar, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Hanging, legs together.
steps: Hang with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Raise your knees or straight legs toward the chest.
Curl the pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Only lifting the legs without curling the pelvis.
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands clasped together in front of the chest.
exercises.stance: Seated, knees bent, heels on the floor (or lifted to make it harder), torso leaning back slightly.
steps: Sit and lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Each side counts as one rep.
cues: Rotate from the ribs, not just the arms.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate.

exercises.grip: Arms extended overhead.
exercises.stance: Lying face down, legs straight.
steps: Lie face down with arms overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for 2 to 3 seconds.
Lower slowly.
cues: Small lift; you don't need height.
mistakes: Lifting too high and straining the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you lift.

exercises.grip: Hands flat under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: High plank, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward the chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.
exercises.breathing: Short, rhythmic breaths.

exercises.grip: No grip; arms move freely.
exercises.stance: Feet together, knees soft.
steps: Stand with feet together.
Jump and spread arms and legs into a star.
Land softly with feet together.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet.
mistakes: Going too fast and losing control.
exercises.breathing: Rhythmic breathing.

exercises.grip: Hands behind the head or swinging for momentum.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Squat down to a comfortable depth.
Jump straight up explosively.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.
Repeat.
cues: Reset between reps if form slips.
mistakes: Doing them when tired and sloppy.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you jump.

exercises.grip: One hand on the kettlebell handle, overhand.
exercises.stance: Feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes slightly out.
steps: Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, hinging at the hips.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Switch hands after the set.
cues: It's a hip hinge, not a squat.
Arm is a rope; the hips do the work.
Stand tall at the top with glutes squeezed.
mistakes: Rounding the back at the bottom.
exercises.breathing: Sharp breath out as the hips snap forward.

exercises.grip: Hands flat under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: On hands and knees, knees under the hips.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Round your back up toward the ceiling, tucking the chin.
Then let the stomach drop and lift the chest.
Move slowly between the two.
cues: Move one segment of the spine at a time.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you round, in as you arch.

exercises.grip: Arms extended forward on the floor.
exercises.stance: Kneeling, big toes together, knees apart.
steps: Kneel and sit back toward your heels.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest.
Rest your forehead on the floor or a cushion.
Hold and breathe.
exercises.breathing: Slow breaths into the back of the ribs.

exercises.grip: Hands on the front knee or hips.
exercises.stance: Half kneeling: one knee down, the other foot forward.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift forward gently until you feel the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Tuck the tailbone; don't arch the back.
Pad under the knee if needed.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing, relax into the stretch.

exercises.grip: Hands may rest lightly on the back of the head (no pulling).
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch along the back of the neck.
Return slowly.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: One hand can rest on the head without pulling.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
Hold a gentle stretch on the opposite side of the neck.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Lifting the shoulder to the ear.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Hands on the thigh of the bent leg.
exercises.stance: One heel forward on the floor with toes up, back knee slightly bent.
steps: Place one heel forward with the toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Hold where you feel the stretch behind the thigh and calf.
Switch sides.
cues: Hinge from the hips, not by rounding.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms wrapped around the shins.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back.
steps: Lie on your back.
Bring both knees toward the chest.
Hug the shins gently.
Hold and relax the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Opposite hand holds the working arm above the elbow.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use the other hand to gently pull it closer.
Hold the stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Switch sides.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Fingers interlaced, palms facing away.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Interlace your fingers in front of you.
Push your hands forward and round your upper back.
Let your head drop slightly.
Hold and breathe into the upper back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe slowly into the upper back.

exercises.grip: Hands loosely clasped or fists.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing.
steps: Hold your arms in front.
Circle the wrists slowly in one direction.
Switch direction halfway.
Keep the movement smooth.
exercises.breathing: Normal breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms extended out to the sides.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Lift your arms out to the sides.
Make small circles, growing bigger.
Reverse direction halfway.
Keep shoulders down.
cues: Good warm-up before upper body work.
exercises.breathing: Normal breathing.

exercises.grip: No grip. Arms hang loose or rest in your lap.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Let your arms hang relaxed.
Roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down in a slow circle.
Switch direction halfway.
Keep the neck long and relaxed.
cues: Squeeze the shoulder blades on the way back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as the shoulders rise, out as they drop.

exercises.grip: Free hand holds the seat or armrest.
exercises.stance: Seated upright on a steady chair, feet flat.
steps: Sit tall with both feet on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead.
Lean gently to the opposite side until you feel the side of your back stretch.
Hold, come back to centre, switch sides.
cues: Both hips stay on the seat.
mistakes: Lifting a hip off the chair.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing into the stretched side.

exercises.grip: Hands on the lower back, fingers pointing down.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Stand tall and place both hands on your lower back.
Point your elbows out to the sides.
Gently draw the elbows back toward each other to open the chest.
Hold, then relax.
cues: Shoulders down, away from the ears.
Opens up a hunched desk posture.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as the chest opens.

exercises.grip: One hand can rest on the desk for balance.
exercises.stance: Standing in a short split stance, front knee soft.
steps: Stand with one foot a step in front of the other.
Bend both knees slightly and lift the back heel.
Tuck your tailbone under and press the back hip forward.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Squeeze the glute of the back leg.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing; relax a little more on each breath out.

exercises.grip: Hold one wrist with the other hand at hip height.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Cross one arm in front of your body.
Hold that wrist with your other hand, elbow slightly bent.
Gently pull the arm across and up toward shoulder height.
Feel the stretch in the upper back, then switch sides.
cues: Stretch should be in the back, not the joint.
exercises.breathing: Slow, steady breathing.

exercises.grip: Hold the sides of the seat.
exercises.stance: Seated near the front of a steady chair.
steps: Sit tall near the front of the chair.
Straighten one leg in front, heel on the floor, toes up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a straight back until the back of the thigh stretches.
Hold, then switch legs.
cues: Hinge at the hips, chest proud.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach further.
Sitting on a chair with wheels.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you hinge forward.

exercises.grip: Palms together or fingers interlaced overhead.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Stand tall and reach both arms straight overhead.
Press the palms together.
Reach up and slightly back, growing tall.
Hold, then lower the arms slowly.
cues: Shoulders away from the ears at the start.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you reach up.

exercises.grip: Palms flat, fingers pointing back toward you.
exercises.stance: Standing at a desk, or kneeling on a mat.
steps: Place your palms flat on the desk (or the floor if kneeling), fingers pointing toward you.
Keep the elbows straight but not locked.
Lean back slowly until the inside of the forearms stretches.
Hold, then turn the hands over (backs flat) for the other side of the forearm.
cues: Lean only as far as is comfortable.
Good for keyboard and phone-heavy days.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on the bar, hands just wider than the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Hanging from the bar with straight arms, feet off the floor or lightly touching a box.
steps: Hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Without bending the elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a few centimetres.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly back to a full hang.
cues: Arms stay straight the whole time.
Think of putting your shoulder blades in your back pockets.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to pull up.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull the shoulder blades down, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Dumbbells held with palms facing your feet or slightly turned in.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back on the floor, knees bent and feet flat.
steps: Lie on the floor holding the dumbbells over your chest, arms straight.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Pause lightly on the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Touch the floor softly, don't bounce.
mistakes: Bouncing the arms off the floor.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other or your legs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, knees soft, hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, chest over the toes.
steps: Hinge forward until your back is at about 45 degrees, dumbbells hanging under the shoulders.
Pull both dumbbells towards your lower ribs, elbows close to the body.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
cues: Flat back, neck in line with the spine.
Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders towards the ears.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Light dumbbells, palms facing each other.
exercises.stance: Hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, knees soft, or seated leaning over your knees.
steps: Let the dumbbells hang under your chest with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise them out to the sides until the arms are in line with the body.
Squeeze between the shoulder blades for a moment.
Lower slowly.
cues: Elbows stay slightly bent and fixed.
Lead with the back of the hands.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight.
Bending and straightening the elbows (turning it into a row).
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip on one dumbbell, palm facing away from your thigh.
exercises.stance: Seated on a bench or chair, feet wide, back of the upper arm resting on the inner thigh.
steps: Sit with feet wide and lean forward a little.
Rest the back of your working upper arm on the inside of the same-side thigh, arm straight.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, moving only the forearm.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until the arm is straight again.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
cues: Upper arm stays pinned to the thigh.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow off the thigh.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: One dumbbell held by the handle, palm facing forward.
exercises.stance: Seated with back support or standing tall, core braced.
steps: Press one dumbbell straight overhead, arm next to your head.
Keeping the upper arm still, lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in the back of the arm.
Straighten the arm back up without moving the upper arm.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
mistakes: Elbow flaring out to the side.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press up.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip on a dumbbell (or a kettlebell by the handle), palm facing your body.
exercises.stance: Hinged forward with a flat back, free hand and knee on a bench or the free hand on your knee.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and support yourself with your free hand.
Lift the working upper arm until it is parallel to the floor, elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Straighten the elbow to push the dumbbell back until the arm is straight.
Squeeze the back of the arm, then lower under control.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
cues: Upper arm stays still and parallel to the floor.
exercises.breathing: Out as you straighten the arm, in as you bend it.

exercises.grip: Single handle on a high pulley, underhand grip.
exercises.stance: Standing facing the machine, one foot slightly ahead for balance.
steps: Hold the handle with the elbow tucked at your side, forearm bent up.
Push the handle down until the arm is straight.
Squeeze, then let it rise slowly back to the start.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you push down, in as it rises.

exercises.grip: One dumbbell, palm facing your body; free hand holding something steady.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, leaning slightly away from the working arm.
steps: Hold a support with your free hand and lean slightly away from it.
With a soft bend in the elbow, raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
exercises.stance: Rear foot on a bench behind you, front foot about two steps forward.
steps: Stand in front of a bench and place the top of your rear foot on it.
Hold the dumbbells at your sides, chest up.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish every rep on one leg, then switch.
cues: Front knee tracks over the toes.
Most of the weight on the front leg.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles.
exercises.stance: Seated in the leg extension machine, knee in line with the pivot, pad on the lower shin.
steps: Set the seat so your knee lines up with the machine's pivot.
With one leg under the pad, straighten the knee fully.
Pause and squeeze the thigh at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack touch.
Finish every rep on one leg, then switch.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat.
Too heavy to pause at the top.
exercises.breathing: Out as you straighten, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A kettlebell or dumbbell in the hand opposite the standing leg.
exercises.stance: Standing on one leg, slight bend in the knee.
steps: Stand on one leg holding the weight in the opposite hand.
Hinge at the hip, sending the free leg straight back as your chest lowers.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the back of the standing leg, back flat.
Drive the hip forward to stand tall again.
Finish every rep on one leg, then switch.
cues: Hips stay square to the floor.
mistakes: Opening the hip to the side.
exercises.breathing: In as you hinge down, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: An end of the band in each hand, palms forward.
exercises.stance: Standing on the middle of the band, feet hip-width.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Curl both hands up towards the shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: One end of the band in the working hand, palm forward.
exercises.stance: Standing on the other end with the same-side foot.
steps: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other.
Curl the hand up towards the shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: One end of a band anchored high, held in one hand.
exercises.stance: Standing facing the anchor, one foot slightly ahead.
steps: Anchor the band above head height and hold it with the elbow bent at your side.
Push the hand down until the arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
mistakes: Letting the band yank the arm up.
exercises.breathing: Out as you push down, in as it rises.

exercises.grip: An end in each hand, neutral grip.
exercises.stance: Seated on the floor, legs straight, band looped around the feet.
steps: Sit tall with the band around your feet.
Pull the hands to your lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Leaning far back to finish the rep.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: One kettlebell by the handle, palm forward.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, feet hip-width.
steps: Hold the kettlebell at your side, arm straight.
Curl it up towards the shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
mistakes: Dropping it on the way down.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A loaded backpack held by its top loop or a strap.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, feet hip-width.
steps: Fill a backpack with books and hold it at your side.
Curl it up towards the shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
cues: Add books when 15 reps are easy.
mistakes: An overloaded bag with a weak strap.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A loaded backpack in one hand, neutral grip.
exercises.stance: One hand and knee on a chair or bed, back flat.
steps: Support yourself on a chair with one hand and knee.
Hold the bag below your shoulder, arm straight.
Pull it to your hip, elbow close to the body.
Lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
cues: Pull towards the hip, not the chest.
mistakes: Twisting the body to lift it.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A loaded backpack held by its top loop.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall, core braced.
steps: Press the bag straight overhead with one hand.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten the arm back up.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press up.

exercises.grip: One kettlebell, neutral grip.
exercises.stance: Hinged forward, free hand on a support, flat back.
steps: Hinge forward and support yourself with the free hand.
Let the kettlebell hang under your shoulder.
Row it to your hip.
Lower slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Both hands around the kettlebell's horns.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, core braced.
steps: Press the kettlebell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Straighten the arms back up.
cues: Elbows point forward, close to the head.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: An end of the band in each hand.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, band anchored under your upper back.
steps: Lie on the band so it runs under your upper back, hands above your forehead, elbows bent.
Straighten the arms towards the ceiling.
Bend back slowly to the start.
mistakes: Letting the band pull the hands down fast.
exercises.breathing: Out as you straighten, in as you bend.

exercises.grip: Hands on the seat for support.
exercises.stance: Seated on a chair, band anchored in front at ankle height around one ankle.
steps: Sit with the band around one ankle, leg straight out in front.
Pull the heel back under the chair against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
cues: Pull the heel all the way back.
mistakes: Letting the band snap the leg forward.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull back, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Hands under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: On hands and knees.
steps: Kneel on all fours, back flat.
Kick one leg back and up, knee bent, until the thigh is in line with your body.
Squeeze the glute, then lower without touching down.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you kick, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in each hand, neutral grip.
exercises.stance: Lying face down on a bench set to a low incline, chest on the pad, feet on the floor.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with the dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.
Row both dumbbells up to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause, then lower slowly until the arms are straight.
cues: Chest stays on the pad: the bench takes the load off your lower back.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad.
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A loaded backpack held by its top loop.
exercises.stance: Hinged forward, free hand on a chair, back flat.
steps: Support yourself on a chair with your free hand, back flat.
Lift the working upper arm parallel to the floor, elbow bent.
Straighten the elbow to push the bag back.
Bend it back slowly.
Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
exercises.breathing: Out as you straighten, in as you bend.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
exercises.stance: Sit back on a bench set to 45 to 60 degrees, arms hanging straight down behind your body.
steps: Let your arms hang straight down, slightly behind your torso.
Curl both dumbbells up without moving your upper arms forward.
Squeeze at the top, then lower all the way until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Upper arms stay pointing at the floor.
Get a full stretch at the bottom of every rep.
Keep your head and back on the bench.
mistakes: Swinging the elbows forward to finish the rep.
Stopping short of straight arms at the bottom.
Going too heavy and lifting the shoulders off the bench.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip on a barbell or EZ bar, hands shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Sit at the preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad, armpits snug to its top edge.
steps: Start with arms almost straight on the pad.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are near vertical.
Lower under control until your elbows are almost straight.
cues: Upper arms stay glued to the pad.
Slow down over the last part of the lowering.
mistakes: Dropping the bar fast at the bottom, which strains the elbow.
Lifting the elbows off the pad.
Leaning back to swing the weight.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip on the machine handles.
exercises.stance: Adjust the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
steps: Start with your arms almost straight.
Curl the handles towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to almost straight arms.
cues: Elbows in line with the machine's pivot.
mistakes: Seat set so the elbows sit off the pivot.
Cutting the bottom half of the rep.
Lifting the hips off the seat.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip on the bar, hands about shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees soft.
steps: Hold the bar at arm's length against your thighs.
Curl it up keeping your elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower all the way down.
cues: Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
Straighten your arms fully at the bottom.
mistakes: Swinging the body to move the bar.
Elbows drifting forward at the top.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Rope attachment on a cable, one end in each hand, palms facing each other.
exercises.stance: Face away from the cable, one foot in front of the other, leaning slightly forward.
steps: Start with your hands behind your head and elbows bent, pointing forward.
Straighten your arms forward and up until your elbows are locked out.
Let your hands come back behind your head for a deep stretch.
cues: Elbows stay close to your head.
Go for a deep stretch at the back of the arm.
Brace your stomach so your back stays still.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you straighten your arms, in as they bend.

exercises.grip: Narrow grip on an EZ bar or straight bar, about a hand-width inside the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Lie on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Hold the bar over your chest with straight arms, then tilt the arms slightly back towards your head.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bar behind the top of your head.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
cues: Upper arms stay still and slightly angled back.
Lower behind the head, not to the forehead.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by moving the upper arms.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you straighten.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders, thumbs around the bar.
exercises.stance: Lie on a bench set to 30 degrees, feet flat, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
steps: Unrack the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to just below your collarbones, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up over your upper chest.
cues: Touch the upper chest every rep.
Use a spotter or safety arms.
mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Bench at 30 degrees under the Smith bar so it lines up with your upper chest.
steps: Twist the bar to unhook it.
Lower to your upper chest, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up and re-hook it at the end of the set.
cues: Set the bench so the bar touches just below the collarbones.
Set the safety stops just above your chest.
mistakes: Bench in the wrong spot, so the bar lands on the neck or the stomach.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Handles at mid-chest height, full grip.
exercises.stance: Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet planted.
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
cues: Shoulder blades stay against the pad.
mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward off the pad.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Hold the handles with a neutral grip, elbows slightly bent.
exercises.stance: Sit tall with your back on the pad; set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
steps: Start with arms open wide and a stretch across the chest.
Bring the handles together in front of you in an arc.
Open back slowly to the stretch.
cues: Keep the same small bend in the elbows throughout.
The slow stretch is the most important part.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows.
Going so wide the front of the shoulder hurts.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you open, out as you squeeze.

exercises.grip: A handle in each hand from cables set at shoulder height or a little higher.
exercises.stance: Stand in the middle with one foot forward, leaning slightly forward.
steps: Start with the arms open and a slight bend at the elbows.
Bring the hands together in a hugging arc in front of your chest.
Let them go back slowly until you feel the stretch.
cues: Elbow bend stays the same throughout.
mistakes: Standing too far forward and losing the stretch.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you open, out as you bring the hands together.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
exercises.stance: Lie on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Press the dumbbells over your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Open the arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Bring them back up over your chest in the same arc.
cues: Stop at a stretch, not at pain.
Squeeze the chest on the way up.
mistakes: Going too heavy and bending the elbows into a press.
Clanging the dumbbells at the top.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you open, out as you close.

exercises.grip: Full grip on the handles, hands just outside the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Sit with your back flat on the pad; set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
steps: Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your hands are at shoulder height.
Repeat without resting at the bottom.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad.
Seat set too low or high.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Grip the handles, wide grip for upper back or close grip for lats.
exercises.stance: Lie face down on the chest pad, feet on the platform.
steps: Lift the bar off the rack with straight arms.
Row it towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower until your arms are straight and your shoulder blades spread.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad to heave the weight.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: One D-handle from the low pulley, held in the hand furthest from the machine.
exercises.stance: Stand side-on to the cable, the cable running across the front of your body.
steps: Start with your hand in front of the opposite hip.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.
cues: Lead with the elbow, not the hand.
mistakes: Leaning far away from the cable.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold the handles of the pec deck with a neutral or overhand grip.
exercises.stance: Sit facing the pad, chest against it; set the handles back to their furthest position.
steps: Start with arms straight out in front.
Sweep the arms out and back until they line up with your body.
Return slowly to the front.
cues: Lead with the backs of the hands.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades hard and turning it into a back exercise.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you open, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Take the cable ends without handles, crossed: left cable in the right hand, right cable in the left.
exercises.stance: Stand in the middle of two pulleys set at shoulder height.
steps: Start with arms crossed in front of you.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc, arms almost straight.
Return slowly to crossed arms.
cues: Keep the arms at shoulder height.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a row.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you open, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Hands on the machine's handles, shoulders under the pads.
exercises.stance: Back flat against the pad, feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
steps: Release the safety handles.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Drive up through the whole foot without locking the knees hard.
cues: Back and hips stay on the pad.
Go as deep as you can control.
mistakes: Half reps with too much weight.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in on the way down, out on the way up.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles.
exercises.stance: Sit with your knees lined up with the machine's pivot, the lap pad snug on your thighs and the leg pad above your heels.
steps: Start with your legs almost straight.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly to almost straight.
cues: Lean your chest slightly forward for a bigger hamstring stretch.
mistakes: Knees out of line with the pivot.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you return.

exercises.grip: No grip. Hands ready in front of your chest to catch yourself.
exercises.stance: Kneel on a cushion with your ankles hooked under something solid (a heavy sofa, a bed frame) or held by a partner.
steps: Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your body forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands, push off lightly and pull back up with your hamstrings.
cues: Hips stay straight; don't bend at the waist.
The slow lowering is the main work.
Start with only the lowering; add the pull-up later.
mistakes: Bending at the hips to make it easier.
Dropping fast instead of fighting the fall.
Doing them on a hard floor without padding.
exercises.breathing: Breathe steadily; don't hold your breath through the lowering.

exercises.grip: Hands on the bar outside the hips; a pad or towel around the bar.
exercises.stance: Upper back against the edge of a bench, feet flat and hip-width apart, bar over the hip crease.
steps: Drive through your heels to lift the hips until your body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top for a second.
Lower your hips until they're just above the floor.
cues: Ribs down: don't arch the back.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to get higher.
Feet too far out, so the hamstrings take over.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in at the bottom, out as you drive up.

exercises.grip: Bar across your upper back, hands just outside the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Balls of your feet on a raised plate or step under the bar, heels hanging off.
steps: Lower your heels as far as they go for a deep stretch.
Pause a second in the stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
cues: Pause in the bottom stretch: it is where most growth comes from.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: A dumbbell in one hand, the other hand on a wall for balance.
exercises.stance: Ball of one foot on a step, the other foot hooked behind it, heel hanging off.
steps: Lower the heel as far as it goes and pause.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
cues: Hold the dumbbell on the same side as the working leg.
Use the wall only for balance.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Rope attachment on a high cable, ends held beside your head.
exercises.stance: Kneel facing the cable, hips over your knees.
steps: Hold the rope by your head; keep your hips still.
Curl your ribs towards your hips, rounding your back.
Uncurl slowly until you feel a stretch in your stomach.
cues: Hips stay still: the spine does the curling.
mistakes: Sitting the hips back and pulling with the arms.
Not rounding the back at all.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out hard as you crunch, in as you uncurl.

exercises.grip: Hands on the wheel's handles.
exercises.stance: Kneel on a mat with the wheel under your shoulders.
steps: Brace your stomach and tuck your hips slightly.
Roll forward as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull the wheel back to your knees using your stomach.
cues: Hips tucked, ribs down the whole time.
Only go as far as you can keep your back flat.
mistakes: Rolling out too far too soon.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you roll out, out as you return.

exercises.grip: Hands slightly wider than the shoulders, fingers spread.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, hips high so your body forms an upside-down V.
steps: Walk your feet in until your hips are high over your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor just in front of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Head travels forward of the hands, making a triangle.
Raise your feet on a step or bed to make it harder.
mistakes: Hips dropping so it turns into a push-up.
Landing on the top of the head.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Hands shoulder-width apart, about a hand-length from the wall.
exercises.stance: Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting on the wall.
steps: Brace your stomach and squeeze your legs together.
Lower slowly until your head lightly touches a folded mat.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Hands, head and elbows make a triangle.
Use a folded mat under your head.
mistakes: Trying it before you can do 10 strict pike push-ups.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Hands a little wider than the shoulders, fingers spread.
exercises.stance: Feet up on a bed, chair or step behind you, body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push the floor away back to straight arms.
cues: Body stays in one straight line.
Chest touches the floor every rep.
The higher the feet, the harder it gets.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

exercises.grip: Hands under your chest, a little closer than shoulder-width.
exercises.stance: Push-up position, body straight from head to heels.
steps: Lower your chest towards your hands, elbows brushing your sides.
Touch your chest near your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
cues: Body stays in a straight line.
Drop to your knees to make it easier.
mistakes: Hands so close that the wrists hurt.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Hug a backpack filled with books against your chest, or wear it on your front.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
steps: Brace your stomach with the bag held high on your chest.
Sit down between your heels as deep as you can with heels down.
Pause a second at the bottom, then drive up.
cues: Bag stays tight to the chest.
Add books week by week, or slow the way down to 3 seconds.
mistakes: Letting the bag pull you forward.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in on the way down, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Hands flat on the wall at chest height, a little wider than your shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet together, an arm's length back from the wall; step further back to make it harder.
steps: Brace your stomach so your body is one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest close to the wall.
Push the wall away until your arms are straight.
cues: Elbows angle back, not straight out to the sides.
Slow down: 2 seconds in, 1 second out.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag or stick out.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Standing so close that the rep is too short.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you lean in, out as you push away.

exercises.grip: Arms crossed on your chest, or held out in front for balance.
exercises.stance: Sit on the front half of a sturdy chair against a wall, feet flat and hip-width apart, a little behind your knees.
steps: Lean your chest forward over your knees.
Push through your whole foot and stand all the way up.
Reach your hips back and sit down slowly, without dropping into the chair.
cues: Nose over toes as you stand.
Knees follow the line of your toes.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you sit, out as you stand.
